citation: Online Safety (Miscellaneous Amendments) Act 2022 (Act 38 of 2022) (Act 38 of 2022)
kind: Act (amends the Broadcasting Act 1994 and the Electronic Transactions Act 2010)
commencement: section 1: comes into operation on a date that the Minister appoints by notification in the Gazette; appointed as 1 February 2023 by S 29/2023. The supplement prints the Bill No. 28/2022 cover and the words "A BILL intituled" above the Act, under the heading "No. 38 of 2022."
